parameters.zhName: 维多利亚哥特排线漫画

parameters.enPrompt: Victorian gothic cartoon language built from fine black-pen contours and disciplined directional crosshatching across pale figures worn furniture and dim interiors, with formal yet subtly uneasy posture; keep an ink-black paper-gray and restrained brown range, dense shadow that never loses the silhouette, and deadpan humor arising from strange ordinary situations, avoiding gore modern anime faces or a generic horror-photo filter

parameters.zhPrompt: 狂躁刮线讽刺画用断裂、尖锐、反复回扫的钢笔线塑造细长失衡的人物，头发、衣摆与四肢沿动作方向爆开，局部墨团和飞白只集中于受力点；纸面保留大量空白，线条越出轮廓却不掩盖动作重心，形成神经质速度与尖锐幽默，避免圆润卡通描边、整齐排线或数字运动模糊
parameters.enPrompt: frenetic scratch-ink caricature using broken spiky repeatedly swept pen marks to construct elongated off-balance figures, with hair garments and limbs exploding along the force direction and dark ink knots concentrated only at stress points; preserve broad white paper, let strokes escape the contour without obscuring the center of gravity, and create nervous speed with cutting humor, avoiding rounded cartoon outlines orderly hatching or digital motion blur

parameters.zhName: 低保真 Zine 日记漫画

parameters.enPrompt: raw low-fidelity zine diary cartoon combining rough black pen, crushed photocopy blacks, taped paper seams and uneven halftone to record immediate emotion, with proportions subtly distorted by the character's mental state and only essential domestic clues behind them; retain misregistration folds and missing ink while keeping gaze and gesture legible, like a hand-bound personal booklet rather than polished line art a commercial collage template or long readable copy

parameters.enPrompt: geometric literary deadpan illustration placing a very small figure inside oversized arches stairs or grid-like space, with a rectangular torso short linear limbs and nearly expressionless face while scale itself carries the humor and metaphor; restrict color to charcoal cream muted red and one gray, using precise edges flat shadows and abundant open field, avoiding corporate infographics monumental photoreal architecture or decorative clutter

parameters.enPrompt: bustling wimmelbook scene fitting many tiny characters and simultaneous micro-stories into one continuous town station or cutaway interior, with each action complete and routes traceable through roads stairs and gaze; use fine pen contours with transparent wash, organize a rich palette by zone and keep every depth plane readable without blur, avoiding cloned figures chaotic crowding or one oversized protagonist

parameters.enPrompt: philosophical collage-and-chalk storybook assembling aged paper translucent tissue pencil charcoal and chalk into one restrained relationship between a figure and symbolic object, preserving torn edges adhesive traces and erased marks as real handmade layers; keep near-white charcoal earth brown and one muted gold accent with broad negative space, letting scale and void create the metaphor, avoiding chaotic photo collage childish stickers or explanatory writing
